parts.label: Part A · Send a PDF Quote
Part B · Send It as an Approval

steps.title: Open the quote
steps.body: From your Jobs list, open the quote you built for the customer. A quote and a job share the same screen in Urable, so everything here works from either.

steps.title: Check the line items
steps.body: Give the Line Items a quick once-over — the services and pricing here are exactly what your customer will see on the quote.

steps.title: Click Send PDF
steps.body: Scroll to the bottom of the line items and click Send PDF. Taxes and fees are already rolled into the total on the right.
steps.note: A PDF quote is informational — the customer doesn't have to do anything with it. If you want a signature and sign-off, send it as an Approval instead (Part B).

steps.title: Pick SMS or Email
steps.body: Choose how it goes out — SMS, Email, or Both. The customer's contact info fills in automatically. Hit SEND when it looks right.
steps.note: Use Preview Email to see exactly what lands in their inbox before you send.

steps.title: Quote delivered
steps.body: That's it — Email deployed! Your customer gets a clean PDF with the services and price. Quick, zero friction, no action needed on their end.

steps.title: Click ADD on the job
steps.body: Want a signed green light instead of just an FYI? From the same job, click + ADD at the bottom of the screen.

steps.title: Choose Approval
steps.body: Pick Approval from the menu. An Approval carries the full job — price, documents, inspection photos, anything you've attached — and asks the customer to sign off on it.

steps.title: Set the message and expiration
steps.body: Add an optional Title, tweak the Comment your customer sees, and set an Expires On date to create a little urgency.

steps.title: Attach your documents
steps.body: Check any Documents that should ride along — service agreements, waivers, T&Cs. The customer sees and signs off on all of it in one place.

steps.title: Open the add-ons
steps.body: Scroll to Additional Options and click Select add-ons. Because Approvals are interactive, this is a built-in upsell moment.

steps.title: Pick an upsell
steps.body: Choose the add-on service — here a Windshield Coating. Your customer can accept it with one tap while they're approving the job.
steps.note: Want customers to schedule themselves right after approving? Turn that on in Preferences > Calendar > External — click Approvals under Online Booking.

steps.title: Send the Approval
steps.body: Pick SMS or Email just like the PDF, then hit SEND. The toggle below lets you hide per-item quantities and unit prices if you'd rather show one number.

steps.title: Signed and documented
steps.body: This is what your customer sees: the full job, your documents, and that add-on toggle they can flip before approving and signing. When they do, you've got a documented go-ahead with the price locked in — attached right to the job.
